title: Build an AI Analyst You Can Trust

slides.title: Two people
slides.body:
One makes demos. Impressive for a week. Trusted with nothing real.

One makes things a team runs on. Looks boring. Gets the budget.

Same tools. One habit apart.
slides.notes: Cast the room: PM, eng lead, exec. Same move tonight: you are hiring a teammate and deciding whether to trust it.

slides.title: Three names. Four numbers. One habit.
slides.body:
Eval: did it do the job. Guardrail: did it avoid harm. Governance: can you prove it to someone who was not in the room.

Groundedness 3 of 4. Completion yes. Cost $0.11. Speed 19s.

You do not test it once. You check every run.
slides.notes: Groundedness is the one nobody tracks and the one that ends careers. The gate never comes off.

slides.title: You already knew how to make the trick.
slides.body:
Now you are the person who can be trusted with it.

Every fact carries the sentence it came from.
Something goes and checks.

khaledzaky.com/trust
